title: area rug
text: area rug. I was happily surprised by the quality (considering the price) of this small area rug.  It is very soft and thick.  It's incredible to walk barefoot on.  The edges are wrap sewn and very tightly.  It is bare woven backed, so I do suggest the additional purchase non-skid pad.  It came rolled, so it needs weight on the corners to encourage them to flatten.  I did  also purchase some removable tape strips to help with that too - but honestly the carpet is heavy enough that a little weight for a few days seemed to work.  The color is as represented in the photos (I ordered the "cream") I appreciated that while it was shipped rolled in super heavy plastic they also put some nice shower cap like covers on each end, so it was very clean and tidy upon arrival.  It's just a very, very lovely rug and an awesome price.  I would purchased again.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
